valuation_philosophy: Tokai Rika is better framed as a deep-value / net-cash / capital-return story than a growth compounder. Net cash of ~JPY83.8bn is ~32% of the ~JPY258.7bn market cap and ~10x FY2026 reported FCF; the stock has traded at a persistent 0.45x-0.89x P/B discount (10yr avg 0.65x) and 1.67x-3.12x EV/EBITDA (10yr avg 2.66x) despite FY2026 being a record earnings year, because FY2027 guidance is an explicit profit DECLINE (op profit -15.8%) and the market has never rewarded this business with anything close to a growth multiple. The DCF below is built bottom-up from FY2027 guidance (the trough year) through a 10-year component build toward partial (not full) progress against the TRV2030 targets, and the terminal value is capped at the stock's own historical EV/EBITDA range rather than a perpetuity-growth exit multiple, because Gordon growth at any plausible WACC/terminal-growth combination would imply a multiple (>6x EV/EBITDA) the market has never paid for this name in 10 years. A supplementary sum-of-parts sanity anchor (net cash ~JPY983/share + capitalized normalized earnings) is consistent with the DCF base case landing modestly above the current price -- this is a legitimate result given the stock re-rated +43% off its FY2025 FY-end price of JPY2,129 into a guided earnings decline, and is NOT manufactured upside: base case upside is 14.9%, well inside the plausible range, and bear case is meaningfully negative (-29.4%).

inputs.sbc_note: SBC is verified NIL across the full FY2017-FY2026 history (StockBasedComp column is 0.0 throughout). This is typical for a Japanese Tier-1 keiretsu supplier and is confirmed, not a data gap -- the SBC adjustment in Step 1b is therefore a no-op here (no dilution, no cash charge to deduct). Recorded explicitly rather than silently skipped.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2026 interest + dividend income = JPY1,307m + JPY623m (as originally reported for FY2026) = JPY1,889m per the FY2026 consolidated statement of income non-operating income section. Net cash (JPY83.8bn) is ~10x FY2026 reported FCF (JPY8.5bn), so per the workflow's >1x materiality rule this is stripped from owner FCF to avoid double-counting the cash pile (once as an FCF contributor, once as a net-debt addition to enterprise value in Step 4.5). The yield is low (~2.3% blended on JPY83.8bn) because a portion of 'cash and equivalents' is working-capital float rather than pure interest-bearing securities.
inputs.sbc_source: 10-K equivalent (Kessan Tanshin) FY2026 cash flow / income statement -- StockBasedComp column verified 0.0 across all 10 fiscal years in Metrics.csv
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 completed a 5-million-share CANCELLATION (issued shares 94,234,171 -> 89,234,171) of already-held treasury stock, not a new open-market cash repurchase drawn from FY2026 financing activities at scale comparable to the cancellation; treasury shares fell from 9,195,446 to 4,126,002 as the cancelled shares were retired. Shares outstanding is therefore modeled as flat-to-modestly-declining (continued cancellation), not diluting -- see annual_share_growth_pct.
inputs.annual_share_growth_note: SBC is nil, so there is no dilution to cover. Share count is instead modeled as continuing a MODEST buyback/cancellation trend (-0.5%/yr base case) given the company's explicit TSE PBR-reform capital-return push (5M-share cancellation just completed, dividend raised to JPY120 guided, payout ratio guided to 51.1%). This is conservative relative to the FY2026 cancellation pace (5.3% of shares in one year).
inputs.units: millions (except per-share and shares_outstanding, which are in millions of shares / JPY per share)

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS 5yr CAGR (22.41%) diverges 75.1% from equity 5yr CAGR (5.58%), and EPS 3yr CAGR (45.35%) is even more extreme -- both are artifacts of the FY2022 trough base (EPS JPY31.77, an operating-profit trough year at 1.8% margin) rather than a genuine step-change in earnings power. Reported and owner FCF CAGRs are both NEGATIVE (-0.6%/-17.6% and -5.8%/-21.0% respectively) purely because FY2021 (a low-capex COVID-recovery year, FCF JPY22.5bn) and FY2024 (a working-capital-favorable year, FCF JPY26.4bn) are unusually high starting/ending points against a capex-heavy FY2026 (FCF JPY8.5bn) -- FCF CAGR is NOT used as the growth driver for this reason; equity CAGR (the most stable, least distorted series) is used instead, consistent with the Growth Rate Selection Logic primary rule.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (ex interest/dividend income) is close to reported FCF every year because SBC=0; the gap between reported and owner FCF is small (JPY0.1-1.8bn/yr) and entirely the interest/dividend strip, not an SBC adjustment. FCF is structurally volatile across the capex cycle (10yr range JPY0.3bn-JPY26.4bn, mean JPY11.7bn, median JPY9.9bn) -- this is why the DCF projection is built bottom-up from EBITDA/capex/D&A components rather than extrapolated from any single historical FCF CAGR.

wacc_rationale.toyota_concentration_note: ~74% of consolidated sales from Toyota + Toyota-affiliated companies, well past the >40% single-customer-concentration threshold that warrants a structural premium
wacc_rationale.cyclicality_note: Operating profit ranged JPY9.2bn (FY2022) to JPY35.6bn (FY2026), ~3.9x peak-to-trough within 5 years, and FY2027 guidance is itself a further -15.8% profit decline off the FY2026 peak
wacc_rationale.governance_note: April-2026 disclosure of a multi-year (FY2021-FY2025) material weakness in internal controls over financial reporting (deferred-tax/retirement-benefit accounting), forcing a 5-year restatement and delaying the FY2026 earnings release; dollar impact was modest (~2%/yr of equity) but it is a genuine, recent control failure
wacc_rationale.size_premium_note: Market cap ~JPY259bn (~USD1.7bn) and TSE Prime-listed -- NOT a micro-cap, no illiquidity/small-cap premium applied
wacc_rationale.bull_bear_note: Bull WACC removes ~1.0pp of the cyclicality/governance premium on the view that TRV2030 execution reduces both; bear WACC adds ~1.5pp on the view that further restatement/control issues or a sharper Toyota-volume downturn would be repriced immediately by the market given the stock's demonstrated multiple compression in FY2020/FY2022

base.revenue_growth_note: Y1 (FY2027) = company guidance +0.8%; Y2+ reflects gradual recovery in Smart System/HMI content mix decelerating toward a 1.5% terminal rate consistent with mature Japanese auto-parts demand
base.op_margin_note: Y1 (FY2027) = company guidance 4.615% (JPY30.0bn / JPY650.0bn); recovers gradually to 6.0% by Y10 (FY2036) -- PARTIAL, not full, progress against the TRV2030 mid-term plan's FY2031 stretch target of 7% operating margin, reflecting the persistent structural net price-down drag the company itself discloses (-JPY12.4bn customer price-down vs +JPY10.6bn recovery = net negative every year)
base.capex_note: Y1 (FY2027) = company guidance JPY33.0bn / JPY650.0bn; tapers from the current TRV2030 investment-cycle peak (FY2026 actual 5.46% of revenue) toward a ~4.0% maintenance level as the capex supercycle (new products/automation/labor-saving + Strategic/Mirai investment) matures
base.wc_capture_note: Working capital modeled as a capture rate on the YEAR-OVER-YEAR REVENUE CHANGE, not a fixed share of revenue -- historical receivables/payables/inventory swings have been small and volatile (no structural deferred-revenue tailwind of the DUOL type), so an 8% capture rate (a modest cash use as revenue grows) is used
base.cash_tax_rate_note: FY2026 effective tax rate = JPY14,200m / JPY45,850m pre-tax = 31.0%, consistent with the Japanese statutory rate (~30-31%) and NOT the product of a one-off valuation-allowance release or credit -- held flat at 30.5%, no ramp needed
base.terminal_growth_note: Capped at 1.5% given Japan's low long-run nominal GDP growth and a mature auto-components end market
base.terminal_cap_note: Set to the 10-year AVERAGE EV/EBITDA (2.66x) actually paid for this stock (range 1.67x-3.12x, FY2017-FY2026 FY-end prices) rather than the workflow's generic 20x default -- this is a low-multiple, cyclical, keiretsu-embedded Tier-1 supplier the market has never priced as a compounder, and Gordon growth at any plausible WACC/terminal-growth pair implies a multiple (>6x) the market has never paid

bull.op_margin_note: TRV2030 targets FULLY achieved: 7% operating margin reached by FY2031 (Y5) as guided, plus continued modest improvement to 7.3% by Y10; Smart System/digital-key content wins outside Toyota accelerate revenue growth
bull.terminal_cap_note: Set to the 10-year MAXIMUM EV/EBITDA actually paid (FY2018 FY-end, 2.93x, rounded up to the FY2021 relative peak of 3.12x) -- even the bull case does not assume the market pays a multiple it has never paid before

bear.op_margin_note: Toyota volumes soften, price-down pressure persists without offsetting recovery, EV transition erodes legacy Key Lock/Steering Wheel lines faster than Smart System can compensate -- margin never recovers meaningfully above the FY2022-23 trough range
bear.terminal_cap_note: Set to the 10-year MINIMUM EV/EBITDA actually paid (FY2020 FY-end, the COVID-demand-shock low)
bear.share_count_note: No buybacks in bear case -- capital preservation, flat share count

base.exit_multiple_flag: Implied exit multiple (2.66x) is BELOW the current EV/EBITDA (2.97x) -- the base case does NOT assume multiple expansion, it assumes reversion to the 10-year average, which is conservative given the current price already sits near the top of the historical multiple range

bull.pb_flag: Bull-case IV implies ~1.24x P/B, ABOVE the 10-year maximum ever paid (0.89x, FY2017) -- this scenario requires BOTH full TRV2030 margin execution AND a structural market re-rating beyond anything observed historically; treat as a genuine stretch case, not a base expectation

bull.assumptions_summary: TRV2030 fully achieved (7%+ op margin by FY2031), stronger Smart System/digital-key content growth, WACC 8.45%, exit multiple capped at 10yr-max 3.12x EV/EBITDA, more aggressive share cancellation (-0.8%/yr)

base.assumptions_summary: FY2027 guided trough as Y1, partial progress toward TRV2030 (margin recovers to 6.0% by Y10, not the 7% stretch target), WACC 9.5%, exit multiple capped at 10yr-average 2.66x EV/EBITDA, modest continued cancellation (-0.5%/yr)

bear.assumptions_summary: Persistent price-down pressure, Toyota volume softness, no margin recovery above FY2022-23 trough range, WACC 10.95%, exit multiple capped at 10yr-minimum 1.67x EV/EBITDA, flat share count (no buybacks)

base.note: Entry price sits at ~79.5% of base intrinsic value, meaningfully below IV (as expected since the 15% hurdle far exceeds the 9.5% WACC and projected base-case growth is low-single-digit, well under 15%) but not implausibly low -- the large net-cash addback (JPY83.8bn, ~JPY1,035/share) supports the entry price even against the high hurdle rate.

sensitivity.note: Standard WACC x terminal-growth matrix is included below for schema compatibility, but is largely FLAT across terminal-growth columns because the EV/EBITDA cap (2.66x, the stock's own 10yr average) binds at every terminal-growth rate from 0.5%-2.5% given the WACC-g spread -- Gordon growth would require a growth rate below -4% to NOT be capped, i.e. the cap is the actual value driver, not terminal growth. A second, more informative matrix (WACC x exit EV/EBITDA multiple) is provided in sensitivity_exit_multiple.

sensitivity_exit_multiple.description: Intrinsic value by WACC (rows) and terminal EV/EBITDA exit multiple (columns) -- this is the sensitivity that actually matters for this name, since the exit multiple (not terminal growth) is the binding terminal-value driver

sanity_check.diagnosis: No trip. Base IV JPY3,493 implies 10.1x P/E (vs 10yr avg 13.8x), 0.85x P/B (vs 10yr max 0.89x) and a terminal 2.66x EV/EBITDA (the 10yr average) -- every implied multiple sits inside the range this stock has actually traded at. Base upside 14.9% is far below the 100% trip threshold. The check passes only BECAUSE the exit-multiple cap was applied pre-emptively: uncapped Gordon growth at 9.5% WACC / 1.5% terminal growth would have implied >6x EV/EBITDA, roughly 2x the highest multiple ever paid, and an IV near JPY6,800.
sanity_check.fix_applied: Terminal value in all three scenarios is bound by the historical EV/EBITDA cap (not Gordon growth) -- see valuation.*.terminal_value_bound = 'cap' in every scenario. This is the single most important discipline in this model: at WACC 9.5% and terminal growth 1.5%, uncapped Gordon growth would imply an EV/EBITDA exit multiple >6x, more than double the highest multiple this stock has ever traded at in 10 years. Applying the cap pulls the base intrinsic value down from an uncapped ~JPY6,800+/share to JPY3,493/share.

historical_multiples_fy_end_march_close.note: SBC is nil throughout so adjusted = unadjusted multiples; no SBC add-back distortion to correct for, unlike SBC-heavy US tech names.

current_multiples.note: Current EV/EBITDA (2.97x) is in the upper portion of the 10yr range (1.67x-3.12x, avg 2.66x); current P/B (0.74x) is above the 10yr average (0.65x) but below the 10yr max (0.89x); current price (JPY3,040) sits in the UPPER DECILE of the 10-year price range (JPY1,311-JPY3,365 per the 10y monthly chart).

upside_over_100pct_with_price_in_upper_h.result: NOT TRIPPED for base case -- base upside is 14.9% (well under 100%), current price is in the upper decile of the 10yr range as flagged, and this is exactly why the terminal value is capped at the historical EV/EBITDA AVERAGE (not the max, not an uncapped Gordon perpetuity) rather than being allowed to imply multiple expansion beyond what the market has ever paid. Bull case (66.3% upside) also stays under 100% and its terminal multiple is capped at the 10yr max (3.12x), never above it.
upside_over_100pct_with_price_in_upper_h.implied_pb_check: Base IV (JPY3,493) implies 0.85x P/B -- above the 10yr average (0.65x) but below the 10yr max (0.89x), so within the historically observed range. Bull IV (JPY5,057) implies 1.24x P/B, ABOVE the 10yr max ever paid -- flagged explicitly in valuation.bull.pb_flag as a genuine stretch case requiring both margin execution AND market re-rating.

notes: This is a 10-year explicit build (not 5) because the FY2027 guided trough margin (4.6% op margin, 1.97% owner-FCF margin) is far below the assumed mature level (6.0% op margin, 3.55% owner-FCF margin by Y10) -- a 5-year horizon would capitalize an immature, still-recovering margin in perpetuity and understate the business.

Net cash (JPY83.8bn, ~32% of market cap) is added to equity value once via net_debt (negative), and interest/dividend income is stripped from the FCF base to avoid double-counting -- both per the workflow's net-cash-materiality rule.
SBC is verified nil; no dilution adjustment needed. Share count is instead modeled with a modest continued buyback/cancellation assumption in base/bull, and held flat in bear.

The April-2026 multi-year internal-control material weakness (deferred-tax/retirement-benefit restatement, FY2021-FY2025) is priced into the model via a +0.5pp WACC governance premium rather than via a direct earnings haircut, since the dollar impact on restated results was modest (~2%/yr of equity) but the qualitative signal (recent, multi-year, forced restatement) warrants a persistent discount rate premium.

FY2026 ordinary profit (JPY43.8bn) included a JPY5.9bn gain on sale of investment securities net of a JPY3.2bn impairment loss -- this is an extraordinary item below the operating line and is explicitly NOT capitalized or extended into the projection; FY2027 guidance itself assumes zero comparable extraordinary items.
